parsed.note_claim: Vaping does not cause popcorn lung, and cigarettes contain diacetyl (far more than e-cigarettes) yet have not caused popcorn lung.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: No, vaping does not cause "popcorn lung", the common name for a rare disease called bronchiolitis obliterans. The disease was found in a group of factory workers exposed to a chemical (diacetyl) used to flavour popcorn. Diacetyl is contained in cigarette smoke
parsed.reason: The page confirms diacetyl is in cigarette smoke and vaping does not cause popcorn lung, but it gives no 750x comparison and does not say cigarettes never caused the disease.
